summary.zh-CN: 上传工单、产品事实库与支持政策即可开始：工单分诊、回复草案、FAQ 沉淀、升级摘要，每条事实指向来源，退款与赔偿决定始终由你做出。
summary.en: Start from uploaded tickets, product facts and support policies: ticket triage, reply drafts, FAQ distillation and escalation summaries, with every fact pointing to its source and refund or compensation decisions always left to you.

now.zh-CN: 按类型与优先级分诊工单，写出判定依据，判定自助、一线回复或升级
now.en: Triage tickets by category and priority with stated rationale, routing to self-service, first-line reply or escalation

now.zh-CN: 为一线可答的工单起草回复，每条事实指向事实库或政策条目，不做退款赔偿承诺
now.en: Draft replies for first-line tickets with every fact pointing to a fact-base or policy entry, and no refund or compensation promises

now.zh-CN: 从已解决工单沉淀 FAQ 条目，去除客户个人信息，标出与既有 FAQ 的重复与过期
now.en: Distill FAQ entries from resolved tickets, strip customer personal data, and flag duplicates and outdated entries in the existing FAQ

now.zh-CN: 为需升级的工单整理摘要：问题、发生条件、影响、已尝试步骤、需对方决定的事项与时限
now.en: Prepare escalation summaries: problem, conditions, impact, steps tried, decisions needed and deadline

now.zh-CN: 发送或发布前核对事实、承诺性措辞、禁用表述与个人信息
now.en: Check facts, promissory wording, forbidden phrases and personal data before sending or publishing

needs.zh-CN: 工单或对话记录、产品事实库、支持政策（升级规则与 SLA）、既有 FAQ
needs.en: Tickets or conversation records, product fact base, support policies (escalation rules and SLA), existing FAQ

needs.zh-CN: 组织自己的分类与优先级规则、回复渠道与语言、禁用表述清单（没有则用方案默认并注明）
needs.en: Your own category and priority rules, reply channel and language, forbidden wording list (defaults are used and noted otherwise)

needs.zh-CN: 可选：飞书、钉钉、语雀、Notion 或 Zapier 连接器，用于读取消息与在你确认后发送或写入
needs.en: Optional: Feishu, DingTalk, Yuque, Notion or Zapier connectors to read messages and send or write after your confirmation

permissions.zh-CN: 只读取你本次提供的文件
permissions.en: Reads only the files you provide for the task

permissions.zh-CN: 需你确认才会做：向客户发送回复、改动工单系统、发布 FAQ、引用客户个人信息
permissions.en: Only with your confirmation: sending replies to customers, changing the ticket system, publishing FAQ entries, quoting customer personal data

permissions.zh-CN: 不代你做退款、赔偿、补偿或例外处理的决定与承诺
permissions.en: Never decides or promises refunds, compensation or exceptions on your behalf

conditions.zh-CN: 2026-09-25 已用真实模型（DeepSeek deepseek-flash，隔离的测试环境）验证：工单分诊、FAQ 沉淀、升级摘要三个模板按合成样例产出结构与期望一致，回复草案逐条引用事实库条目并做措辞核对，升级类工单不起草对外回复、个人信息只保留工单编号。
conditions.en: Verified with a real model (DeepSeek deepseek-flash, isolated test environment) on 2026-09-25: ticket triage, FAQ distillation and escalation summary matched the expected structure on synthetic samples; reply drafts cite fact-base entries with wording checks, escalated tickets get no outbound draft, personal data reduced to ticket ids.

conditions.zh-CN: 工单系统、即时通讯与知识库连接为可选项，本版不内置。
conditions.en: Ticket system, messaging and knowledge base connections are optional and not bundled in this version.
